bio.text: J.D. Scholten is a Democratic state representative for Iowa House District 1 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.

The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Scholten as a paralegal, former nonprofit director and retired professional baseball player, with a B.A. in history from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
It says Scholten was born in 1980 in Ames and was raised and lives in Sioux City.
